translationRepairs: As a young man he was upright and studious; through hereditary privilege he began his career as cavalry adjutant in the Left Weiming Guard and was later posted as registrar at Tongguan.

左威衛 is the Left Weiwei Guard; 威 is wei.
In youth he was upright and fond of learning; through yin privilege he entered service as Cavalry Army Adjutant of the Left Weiming Guard, and went out as registrar at Tongguan.
In youth he was upright and fond of learning; through yin privilege he entered service as Cavalry Army Adjutant of the Left Weiwei Guard, and went out as registrar at Tongguan.

員外郎 is the office vice director, not 'external vacancy'; 祠部 is the Bureau of Sacrifices and 孝功 stands for 考功 Merit Evaluation.

In winter of the Jianzhong year, when the Jingzhou troops revolted, Dezong went out on campaign, the Yellow River region and Bian were in turmoil; Huang trained soldiers and sharpened weapons and armor, which were called elite.
